title: US Letter Poster Maker — Print Big Posters on 8.5×11
description: Split big photos, banners, and PDFs across standard 8.5×11 US Letter sheets. Live inch dimensions, crop marks, glue tabs, and 100% local export.
lead: Pre-configured for North American 8.5 × 11 inch US Letter paper and inch measurements. Print 18×24, 24×36, or giant wall banners at home.

sections.heading: Print 18×24 and 24×36 Inch Posters on Standard 8.5×11 Paper
paragraphs: Most US home printers take 8.5 × 11 inch Letter paper (215.9 × 279.4 mm). By setting Size By to Poster Width and choosing inches, you can dial in exact 18, 24, or 36 inch dimensions without doing millimeter math.
WidePosterMaker also supports US Legal (8.5 × 14 in) in the paper selector if you want fewer horizontal seam joints on tall portraits or banners.

sections.heading: Check Your Printer Margin Before Printing
paragraphs: Most US inkjet and laser printers clip 0.2 to 0.25 inches (5–6 mm) around each edge. Keeping Printer Margin at 6 mm and Glue Overlap at 12 mm (~0.5 in) gives generous overlap tabs and prevents missing artwork at seams.

faqs.q: How many 8.5×11 sheets does a 24×36 poster take?
faqs.a: Accounting for a 6 mm (~0.24 in) printer margin and 12 mm (~0.47 in) glue overlap, a 24 × 36 inch poster takes a 3 × 5 grid of 15 Letter sheets (10 on US Legal). Auto orientation picks the layout with the fewest sheets.

faqs.q: Does the Assembly Map include an inch ruler too?
faqs.a: Yes. Page 1 prints both an exact 50 mm metric bar and an exact 2.0 inch calibration ruler with half-inch ticks so you can verify scale with any standard ruler.

faqs.q: Can I switch between US Letter and US Legal?
faqs.a: Yes. Open the Paper Size dropdown and choose US Letter (8.5 × 11 in) or US Legal (8.5 × 14 in) at any time.

faqs.q: Is there any limit on image file size?
faqs.a: Because everything processes locally on your machine and images are embedded only once without re-slicing into dozens of JPEGs, large high-resolution files export quickly with low memory use.
